content: Pol na waikaiwama
Mamaitua tauwai yawasanidama be Yesu Keriso, taudi a vinegu be a riu vavasaḡegu da taugu Pol apasol è tubuḡana. Be Yesu Keriso tauna vutuna tà raberabena da tokare tà kitana.
Tam Timoti ḡarome uma letanama yà girugirumina. Am waisumaḡe tam taugu natuḡomiguma. Tamadama Mamaitua be dà Badama Yesu Keriso adi raukiviverema, adi raunuatoima be adi subama ḡarome ta kenana.
Tauwai katakatai kaikaiyovudima kwai ḡakedina

Raḡanine taugu Masedonia provinsnama naḡonama aubainama, taugu è riu vavasaḡemna da tam Epeses meagainama nopone kwa mia be tauwai katakatai kaikaiyovudima matabudi kwai ḡakedi da nam kaiyovue banaga tai katakataidi.
Be mate taudi nam giu poredima kaikaiyovudie

bo kimta poredima ḡarodie sibo yawasana a kerikeri wanedi. Inam kauidie taudi adi raḡanima tawai yakaredina. Taudi nam sibo inam yabedima ai tarapiriedi be a kawa nuaraḡeraḡedi, baninama inam kauidie waikawa saḡasaḡa ta tubutubuḡana. Inam kauidima tokare nam dà waisumaḡe ta saguda, be Mamaitua tài muriwatane, ibewa.

Yau riuvavasaḡama yà riuriuemna tokare na damonama inam wainuapaḡo. Be inam wainuapaḡonama inam nopodima vereverene be adi noḡotama vereverene tai nuapaḡona. Yodibe adi waisumaḡama tokare ei rewapana, be tauwai katakatai kaikaiyovudima nam tai muriwatanedi.
Be banaga ḡesaudima inam yabedima veredima kaiteka a gosedi, be giu kavekavedima tawai tarapiriedina.

Taudi ta noḡonoḡota munaḡedina da taudi kabe tarawatu tauwai katakataidima veredi, be ibewa. Be avedi da adi giuma vaiedima ai rewapana kauana, be yaḡoro taudi aba ta giugiuedina, banidima nam ti kataiedina.
Tauda tè kataiena da tarawatu inam yaba verenama, deḡoda tarawatu banaga tà giu waibatedina.

Be mate tè kataiena da Mamaitua tarawatu ya voiena nam banaga veredima aubaidi, ibewa da banaga gewegewedima aubaidima, • taudi aitauḡa tarawatu tauwai katikotovidima, • aitauḡa tarawatu taurawaḡaiḡaiedima, • aitauḡa Mamaitua tauriutuatuaḡaienama, • aitauḡa gewagewa tauwai nuapaḡoenama, • aitauḡa nopo miremiredima, • aitauḡa Mamaitua tauwai diboḡinama, • aitauḡa tametamedi, tinetinedima be banaga ḡesaudima mate tauwai guridima. • Bo aitauḡa

tauwai soḡa yabayababa, • aitauḡa monamonaḡedima ta gosedi be ta naḡo waiwaivi adi banagama waiwaivi mate be tautauḡoma adi banaga tautauḡoma mate tawai kawa soḡana, • taudi aitauḡa banaga ta danenedi be ta rarau gimaredina, • taudi aitauḡa tawai kaikaiyovu be etare tawai bovibovina, • be taudi aitauḡa yaba toitoi gewegewedima ta voivoiedina, be inam yabedima Mamaitua na waikatakataima didimanidima nopodie nam tima kenakena. Inam nama banegidima aubaidima Mamaitua tarawatu ya voiedina.
Be waikatakatai riuriukauinama inam vari verenama nopone e kenakenana. Inam varinama vutuna Mamaitua ya utegu be yà rarau guguyena. Tauna vutuna boruboruminama, be ya vere vavasaḡana.
Pol Mamaitua yai kaiwena na raunuatoima aubainama
Taugu èi nuavere kauana, baninama dà Badama Yesu Keriso rewapana ya utegu be ya noḡoti da taugu patupatutuguma, vutuna aubainama ya vinegu da taugu na noyama yà voivoiena,

avedi da taugu boni sorukeakea banegiguma, Keriso èwai diboḡi, be tauwai sumaḡenama è raraukivi gewegewedina. Be Yesu Keriso ya raunuatoieguna, baninama inam raḡanine taugu nam e kataiena aba è voivoie. Inam raḡanine taugu yaḡoro nam ewai sumaḡana.

Be dà Badama na raunuatoima ḡarogue ya yovo be ya voiegu da tauna èi sumaḡe, be wainuapaḡo nopoguma ya moḡavuna. Deḡoda tauda dà Badama Yesu Keriso mate tà mia tenaḡana, inam kauidima nama tokare ḡarode ta tubuḡana.

Banaga matabudi sibo a kataie da taugu aba yà giuena inam giu riuriukauinama be taudi sibo ai aninena: Yesu Keriso dobue ya yovona, banaga gewegewedima ei yawasanidina aubainama. Be matabudi nopodie taugu naumeki è gewagewa vavasaḡana,

vutuna aubainama Yesu Keriso ya raunuatoieguna da tokare banaga matabudi ḡarogue ta kita be ta kataie da tauna ewai raba nuetauna da gewagewa banegidima tokare yawasana kenakena nonoḡinama e utedina, deḡoda taudi Keriso tai sumaḡena raḡanine.

Mamaitua tauna guyau miamia nonoḡinama. Tauna miamia moisirinama be guri nam i kataiena, tauna taunaḡa vutuna Mamaitua, be banaga matabuda sibo tauna isanama tè kawa saḡe be tè kaisuḡusuḡu nonoḡena. Inam riukaua.
Pol Timoti nuanama ya boruna
Timoti natuguma, uma giudima taugu yà riuemna: Aba noḡone awai perovetaena ḡarome ta tubuḡana, vutudi kwa noḡotidina. Tam inam riudima kwa ragaudi be vari verenama aubainama kwai ḡavia kauana.

Be am waisumaḡama kwa kaididi da badonaḡa, be noḡota didimanidima aba nuama e riuriuemna nama kwa voiedina, inam kedane tokare kwai ḡavia kauana. Banaga ḡesaudima taudi noḡota didimanidima aba nuedima ya riuriuena nama nam ti voiedina, be tauwai katakatai kaikaiyovudima awai muriwatanedina. Vutuna aubainama adi waisumaḡama ya kovina, maika waga kabe kira debane i raukaisaḡa be i monumonu.
Tautauḡoma rabui isedima Himeneas be Alexanda taudi mate inam banegidima nopodie. Vutuna aubainama Seitan nimane è biridina, dabudine taudi sibo a kataie be nam Mamaitua sibo ai diboḡa munaḡe.

footnotes.text: Giu poredima maika wamba kumakuma, be ḡesaudima mate.
